diagnose_build_ext_error: diagnose a build_ext error by analyzing the exception type and providing actionable error messages
diagnose_compile_error: diagnose a compilation error by checking for missing Python.h headers and missing Cython source files
diagnose_attribute_error: diagnose an attribute error caused by missing _needs_stub in older setuptools versions
compile_c_source: compile a C source string using a distutils compiler in a temporary directory
expect_compile_check: expect a C source string to compile successfully and raise an error if it fails
